title: New trailer for Ray Gunn, Brad Bird's animated film for Netflix
summary: The sci-fi detective story opens in selected cinemas on 4 December and streams from 18 December.
body:
Netflix has released a new trailer for Ray Gunn, the animated science-fiction detective film from Brad Bird, the director of The Incredibles and The Iron Giant.

The film will be shown in selected cinemas, including 70mm screenings, from 4 December, and arrives on Netflix on 18 December.

The voices

Sam Rockwell voices the private detective Raymond Gunn, with Scarlett Johansson as Venus Nova and Tom Waits also in the cast. Other voices include Alan Tudyk, Matt Berry, Bobby Cannavale, Michelle Rodriguez and Patton Oswalt.

It is Bird's first animated film since Incredibles 2 in 2018.

Sources: The Playlist, BroadwayWorld, Collider.
